title_en: Protective orders for domestic violence in {state}
title_es: Órdenes de protección por violencia doméstica en {state_es}
search_intent_en: how to get a protective order in {state}
how long does a protective order last in {state}

facts.claim_en: There is no fee to file a petition for an Arizona Order of Protection or to have it served.
facts.claim_es: No hay que pagar para presentar una petición de Orden de Protección en Arizona ni para que se notifique.
facts.source_name: Arizona Judicial Branch Legal Info Hub: Domestic Violence
facts.quote: There is no fee to file a petition for an Order of Protection or to have it served on the person from whom you are seeking protection.

facts.claim_en: AZPOINT is a free online tool that helps you fill out protective order paperwork.
facts.claim_es: AZPOINT es una herramienta en línea gratuita que le ayuda a llenar los documentos de la orden de protección.
facts.source_name: Arizona Judicial Branch Legal Info Hub: Domestic Violence
facts.quote: is a free application that’s designed to help you fill out the paperwork for a protective order.

facts.claim_en: Arizona law lists 30 crimes that count as domestic violence when committed within a family or intimate relationship.
facts.claim_es: La ley de Arizona enumera 30 delitos que cuentan como violencia doméstica cuando ocurren dentro de una relación familiar o íntima.
facts.source_name: Arizona Judicial Branch Legal Info Hub: Domestic Violence
facts.quote: Arizona law currently includes 30 crimes that, when combined with an intimate partner, a family, or a romantic or sexual relationship, equal domestic violence.

facts.claim_en: If you file on paper, the court provides the forms at no cost.
facts.claim_es: Si presenta en papel, el tribunal le da los formularios sin costo.
facts.source_name: Arizona Judicial Branch Legal Info Hub: Domestic Violence
facts.quote: If you wish to file your documents on paper, the court will provide the forms to you at no cost.

official_links.label_en: Arizona Judicial Branch Legal Info Hub: Domestic Violence
official_links.label_es: Arizona Judicial Branch Legal Info Hub: Domestic Violence

facts.claim_en: An Arkansas judge can issue a temporary order with a hearing set within 30 days.
facts.claim_es: Un juez de Arkansas puede dictar una orden temporal con una audiencia dentro de 30 días.
facts.source_name: Arkansas Judiciary: Order of Protection packet
facts.quote: The Judge has the ability to issue a Temporary Protective Order that includes a hearing date to be held within 30 days

facts.claim_en: Violating an Arkansas order of protection is a Class A misdemeanor.
facts.claim_es: Violar una orden de protección en Arkansas es un delito menor de Clase A.
facts.source_name: Arkansas Judiciary: Ex Parte Order of Protection form
facts.quote: A violation of the order of protection is a Class A misdemeanor

facts.claim_en: A violation after a prior conviction for violating an order is a Class D felony.
facts.claim_es: Una violación después de una condena previa por violar una orden es un delito grave de Clase D.
facts.source_name: Arkansas Judiciary: Ex Parte Order of Protection form
facts.quote: previous conviction for violation of an order of protection is a Class D felony

official_links.label_en: Arkansas Judiciary: Order of Protection packet
official_links.label_es: Arkansas Judiciary: Order of Protection packet

official_links.label_en: Arkansas Judiciary: Ex Parte Order of Protection form
official_links.label_es: Arkansas Judiciary: Ex Parte Order of Protection form

facts.claim_en: A judge decides quickly whether to grant temporary protection (a temporary restraining order).
facts.claim_es: Un juez decide rápidamente si concede protección temporal (una orden de restricción temporal).
facts.source_name: California Courts Self-Help Guide: Domestic Violence Restraining Orders
facts.quote: A judge will decide whether to grant you temporary protection right away.

facts.claim_en: A long-term domestic violence restraining order can last up to 5 years.
facts.claim_es: Una orden de restricción por violencia doméstica a largo plazo puede durar hasta 5 años.
facts.source_name: California Courts Self-Help Guide: Domestic Violence Restraining Orders
facts.quote: If the judge grants you a long-term restraining order, it can last up to 5 years

facts.claim_en: The person you want protection from must be served with the court papers.
facts.claim_es: La persona de quien quiere protección debe ser notificada con los documentos del tribunal.
facts.source_name: California Courts Self-Help Guide: Domestic Violence Restraining Orders
facts.quote: The other side (person you want protection from) must be served with (given) the court papers filed with the court.

facts.claim_en: There is no fee to ask the court to renew your order.
facts.claim_es: No hay que pagar para pedir al tribunal que renueve su orden.
facts.source_name: California Courts Self-Help Guide: Renew a Domestic Violence Restraining Order
facts.quote: There is no fee to ask the court to renew your order.

official_links.label_en: California Courts Self-Help Guide: Domestic Violence Restraining Orders
official_links.label_es: California Courts Self-Help Guide: Domestic Violence Restraining Orders

official_links.label_en: California Courts Self-Help Guide: Renew a Domestic Violence Restraining Order
official_links.label_es: California Courts Self-Help Guide: Renew a Domestic Violence Restraining Order

facts.claim_en: The Permanent Protection Order hearing is usually set within 14 days of the Temporary Protection Order hearing.
facts.claim_es: La audiencia de la Orden de Protección Permanente suele fijarse dentro de los 14 días de la audiencia de la Orden Temporal.
facts.source_name: Colorado Judicial Branch: Getting a Protection Order
facts.quote: The Permanent Protection Order hearing is usually set within 14 days from your Temporary Protection Order hearing

facts.claim_en: For orders filed on or after July 1, 2013, a restrained person must wait 2 years after the permanent order before asking to dismiss it.
facts.claim_es: Para órdenes presentadas desde el 1 de julio de 2013, la persona restringida debe esperar 2 años después de la orden permanente antes de pedir que se anule.
facts.source_name: Colorado Judicial Branch: Getting a Protection Order
facts.quote: If the Protection Order was filed on or after July 1, 2013, you must wait 2 years after issuance of the Permanent Protection Order

facts.claim_en: For orders filed before July 1, 2013, the wait is 4 years.
facts.claim_es: Para órdenes presentadas antes del 1 de julio de 2013, la espera es de 4 años.
facts.source_name: Colorado Judicial Branch: Getting a Protection Order
facts.quote: If the Protection Order was filed before July 1, 2013, you must wait 4 years after the issuance of the Permanent Protection Order

official_links.label_en: Colorado Judicial Branch: Getting a Protection Order
official_links.label_es: Colorado Judicial Branch: Getting a Protection Order

facts.claim_en: A state marshal works to serve a restraining order no later than 3 days before the hearing.
facts.claim_es: Un alguacil estatal procura notificar la orden de restricción a más tardar 3 días antes de la audiencia.
facts.source_name: Connecticut Judicial Branch: Restraining order guide (FM-259)
facts.quote: The state marshal will work to do a service of the restraining order no later than 3 days before the hearing date

facts.claim_en: Civil protection order papers are served no later than 5 days before the hearing.
facts.claim_es: Los documentos de una orden de protección civil se notifican a más tardar 5 días antes de la audiencia.
facts.source_name: Connecticut Judicial Branch: Restraining order guide (FM-259)
facts.quote: civil protection order papers no later than 5 days before the hearing date.

facts.claim_en: Give the papers to a marshal as soon as possible because time is short.
facts.claim_es: Entregue los documentos a un alguacil lo antes posible porque el tiempo es corto.
facts.source_name: Connecticut Judicial Branch: Restraining order guide (FM-259)
facts.quote: Because time is short, give the papers to a marshal as soon as possible.

official_links.label_en: Connecticut Judicial Branch: Restraining order guide (FM-259)
official_links.label_es: Connecticut Judicial Branch: Restraining order guide (FM-259)

facts.claim_en: Violating a Delaware PFA order is a crime punishable by up to one year in jail and/or a fine up to $2,300.
facts.claim_es: Violar una orden PFA en Delaware es un delito que se castiga con hasta un año de cárcel y/o una multa de hasta $2,300.
facts.source_name: Delaware Family Court: Protection From Abuse
facts.quote: The violation of a PFA Order is a crime punishable by up to one year in jail and/or a fine of up to $2,300.

facts.claim_en: If you believe you are in immediate danger, you may ask for an emergency (ex parte) hearing the same day.
facts.claim_es: Si cree que corre peligro inmediato, puede pedir una audiencia de emergencia (ex parte) el mismo día.
facts.source_name: Delaware Family Court: Protection From Abuse
facts.quote: If the person filing believes they are in immediate danger of abuse, they may ask for an emergency (ex parte) hearing that same day.

facts.claim_en: Emergency requests filed after 3:30pm are heard the next business morning.
facts.claim_es: Las solicitudes de emergencia presentadas después de las 3:30 p. m. se atienden la mañana del siguiente día hábil.
facts.source_name: Delaware Family Court: Protection From Abuse
facts.quote: requests for an emergency PFA hearing filed after 3:30pm will be heard the morning of the next business day.

official_links.label_en: Delaware Family Court: Protection From Abuse
official_links.label_es: Delaware Family Court: Protection From Abuse

facts.claim_en: A DC civil protection order is issued by a judge and can last up to one year.
facts.claim_es: Una orden de protección civil en DC la dicta un juez y puede durar hasta un año.
facts.source_name: DC Metropolitan Police Department
facts.quote: A civil protection order is a court order issued by a judge, lasting up to one year

facts.claim_en: In D.C., a temporary protection order lasts up to 14 days at first, to allow service and the hearing.
facts.claim_es: En D.C., una orden de protección temporal dura inicialmente hasta 14 días para permitir la notificación y la audiencia.
facts.quote: A temporary protection order shall remain in effect for an initial period not to exceed 14 days as necessary to complete service and the hearing on the petition.

facts.claim_en: A D.C. civil protection order lasts for an initial period of up to 2 years.
facts.claim_es: En D.C., una orden de protección civil dura un período inicial de hasta 2 años.
facts.quote: A civil protection order issued pursuant to this section shall remain in effect for an initial period not to exceed 2 years.

facts.claim_en: In D.C., violating a protection order can be punished by up to 180 days in jail, a fine, or both.
facts.claim_es: En D.C., violar una orden de protección puede castigarse con hasta 180 días de cárcel, una multa o ambas.
facts.quote: imprisonment for not more than 180 days, or both

facts.claim_en: Florida has no minimum residency requirement to petition for a domestic violence injunction.
facts.claim_es: Florida no exige un tiempo mínimo de residencia para pedir una orden judicial de protección por violencia doméstica.
facts.source_name: Florida Statutes § 741.30
facts.quote: There is no minimum requirement of residency to petition for an injunction for protection.

facts.claim_en: Florida law prohibits charging a filing fee for a domestic violence injunction petition.
facts.claim_es: La ley de Florida prohíbe cobrar una tarifa de presentación por una petición de orden de protección por violencia doméstica.
facts.source_name: Florida Statutes § 741.30
facts.quote: the assessment of a filing fee for a petition for protection against domestic violence is prohibited

facts.claim_en: A Florida temporary injunction issued without notice (ex parte) lasts no more than 15 days, and a full hearing is set before it ends.
facts.claim_es: En Florida, una orden temporal emitida sin aviso (ex parte) dura como máximo 15 días, y se fija una audiencia completa antes de que venza.
facts.source_name: Florida Statutes § 741.30
facts.quote: Any such ex parte temporary injunction shall be effective for a fixed period not to exceed 15 days. A full hearing, as provided by this section, shall be set for a dat

facts.claim_en: A Florida final injunction restraining the respondent stays in effect until a court modifies or dissolves it.
facts.claim_es: En Florida, una orden judicial final que restringe al demandado sigue vigente hasta que el tribunal la modifique o la anule.
facts.source_name: Florida Statutes § 741.30
facts.quote: shall remain in effect until modified or dissolved

facts.claim_en: There is no cost to file for a protective order under Georgia's Family Violence Act.
facts.claim_es: No cuesta nada pedir una orden de protección bajo la Ley de Violencia Familiar de Georgia.
facts.source_name: Georgia.gov: Get a Protective Order
facts.quote: There is no cost to file a petition for a protective order under Georgia's Family Violence Act.

facts.claim_en: Your first court appearance may be an ex parte hearing, as soon as the day you file.
facts.claim_es: Su primera comparecencia puede ser una audiencia ex parte, incluso el mismo día en que presenta.
facts.source_name: Georgia.gov: Get a Protective Order
facts.quote: Your first court appearance may be an ex parte hearing, which can occur as soon as the day you file your petition.

facts.claim_en: A full hearing is generally scheduled within 30 days after the petition is filed.
facts.claim_es: La audiencia completa generalmente se fija dentro de los 30 días después de presentar la petición.
facts.source_name: Georgia.gov: Get a Protective Order
facts.quote: A full hearing is generally scheduled within 30 days after the petition is filed.

facts.claim_en: Temporary protective orders typically last six to 12 months, unless the court orders otherwise.
facts.claim_es: Las órdenes de protección temporales suelen durar de seis a 12 meses, salvo que el tribunal ordene otra cosa.
facts.source_name: Georgia.gov: Get a Protective Order
facts.quote: Temporary protective orders typically remain in effect for six to 12 months

facts.claim_en: Violating a Hawaii court order is contempt of court and a misdemeanor.
facts.claim_es: Violar una orden judicial en Hawái es desacato y un delito menor.
facts.source_name: Hawaii State Judiciary: Protective Order Violations
facts.quote: Violating a court order is called contempt of court and is a misdemeanor criminal offense.

facts.claim_en: A first temporary restraining order violation can bring 48 hours in jail; later violations, 30 days.
facts.claim_es: Una primera violación de una orden de restricción temporal puede conllevar 48 horas de cárcel; las siguientes, 30 días.
facts.source_name: Hawaii State Judiciary: Going to Trial
facts.quote: may be sentenced to 48 hours in jail for the first temporary restraining order violation and 30 days in jail for subsequent violations.

facts.claim_en: A Hawaii temporary restraining order is valid for 180 days unless the court orders otherwise.
facts.claim_es: Una orden de restricción temporal en Hawái es válida por 180 días, salvo que el tribunal ordene otra cosa.
facts.source_name: Hawaii State Judiciary: Extending Your TRO
facts.quote: A temporary restraining order (TRO) is valid for 180 days from the time the TRO is granted and filed.

official_links.label_en: Hawaii State Judiciary: Protective Order Violations
official_links.label_es: Hawaii State Judiciary: Protective Order Violations

official_links.label_en: Hawaii State Judiciary: Going to Trial
official_links.label_es: Hawaii State Judiciary: Going to Trial

official_links.label_en: Hawaii State Judiciary: Extending Your TRO
official_links.label_es: Hawaii State Judiciary: Extending Your TRO

facts.claim_en: Idaho charges no filing, service or hearing fee for a petition seeking only a domestic violence protection order.
facts.claim_es: Idaho no cobra tarifas de presentación, notificación ni audiencia por una petición que solo pide una orden de protección por violencia doméstica.
facts.source_name: Idaho Code § 39-6305
facts.quote: No filing fee, service fee, hearing fee or bond shall be charged for proceedings seeking only the relief provided under this chapter.

facts.claim_en: After a sworn petition is filed, an Idaho court holds a hearing on the protection order within 14 days.
facts.claim_es: Después de presentar una petición jurada, un tribunal de Idaho celebra una audiencia sobre la orden de protección dentro de 14 días.
facts.source_name: Idaho Code § 39-6306
facts.quote: the court shall hold a hearing to determine whether the relief sought shall be granted within fourteen (14) days

facts.claim_en: Relief in an Idaho protection order, other than costs, lasts a fixed period of up to one year, and can be continued on motion for good cause.
facts.claim_es: La protección de una orden en Idaho, salvo las costas, dura un período fijo de hasta un año y puede prolongarse a solicitud con causa justificada.
facts.source_name: Idaho Code § 39-6306
facts.quote: Any relief granted by the protection order, other than a judgment for costs, shall be for a fixed period not to exceed one (1) year; provided, that an order obtained pursuant to this chapter may, upon motion and upon good cause shown, continue

facts.claim_en: In Idaho, violating a protection order after notice is a misdemeanor punishable by up to one year in jail and a fine up to $5,000.
facts.claim_es: En Idaho, violar una orden de protección después de ser notificado es un delito menor castigado con hasta un año de cárcel y una multa de hasta $5,000.
facts.source_name: Idaho Code § 39-6312
facts.quote: a violation of the provisions of the order or of a provision excluding the person from a residence shall be a misdemeanor punishable by not to exceed one (l) year in jail and a fine not to exceed five thousand dollars ($5,000)

facts.claim_en: An Iowa domestic abuse protective order is for a fixed period of up to one year, and the court may extend it after notice and a hearing.
facts.claim_es: Una orden de protección por abuso doméstico en Iowa dura un período fijo de hasta un año, y el tribunal puede prorrogarla tras notificación y audiencia.
facts.source_name: Iowa Code § 236.5
facts.quote: a protective order, or approved consent agreement shall be for a fixed period of time not to exceed one year. The court may amend or extend its order or a consent agreement at any time upon a petition filed by either party and after notice and hear

facts.claim_en: An Iowa court can issue temporary orders, including temporary custody or visitation, before the hearing in an ex parte proceeding when there is good cause.
facts.claim_es: Un tribunal de Iowa puede dictar órdenes temporales, incluida la custodia o las visitas temporales, antes de la audiencia en un procedimiento ex parte cuando hay causa justificada.
facts.source_name: Iowa Code § 236.4
facts.quote: including temporary custody or visitation orders pursuant to subsection 3, upon good cause shown in an ex parte proceeding

facts.claim_en: In Iowa, violating a domestic abuse protective order is a simple misdemeanor, or the court may hold the person in contempt instead.
facts.claim_es: En Iowa, violar una orden de protección por abuso doméstico es un delito menor simple, o el tribunal puede declarar a la persona en desacato.
facts.source_name: Iowa Code § 664A.7
facts.quote: constitutes a public offense and is punishable as a simple misdemeanor. Alternatively, the court may hold a person in contempt of court for such a violation

facts.claim_en: Kansas charges no docket fee for a protection from abuse case.
facts.claim_es: Kansas no cobra tarifa de registro por un caso de protección contra el abuso.
facts.source_name: Kansas Statutes § 60-3104
facts.quote: No docket fee shall be required for proceedings under the protection from abuse act.

facts.claim_en: In Kansas, a hearing is held within 21 days of filing a protection from abuse petition.
facts.claim_es: En Kansas, se celebra una audiencia dentro de los 21 días de presentar una petición de protección contra el abuso.
facts.source_name: Kansas Statutes § 60-3106
facts.quote: Within 21 days of the filing of a petition under this act a hearing shall be held

facts.claim_en: A Kansas protective order lasts a fixed period of at least one year and no more than two years.
facts.claim_es: Una orden de protección en Kansas dura un período fijo de al menos un año y no más de dos años.
facts.source_name: Kansas Statutes § 60-3107
facts.quote: shall be for a fixed period of time not less than one year and not more than two years

facts.claim_en: On the plaintiff's motion, a Kansas order may be extended for at least one more year and up to three years.
facts.claim_es: A solicitud de la parte demandante, una orden en Kansas puede prorrogarse por al menos un año más y hasta tres años.
facts.source_name: Kansas Statutes § 60-3107
facts.quote: Upon motion of the plaintiff, such period may be extended for an additional period of not less than one year and not more than three years.

facts.claim_en: In Kentucky you can get a protective order 24 hours a day.
facts.claim_es: En Kentucky puede obtener una orden de protección las 24 horas del día.
facts.source_name: Kentucky Court of Justice: Protective Orders booklet
facts.quote: You can obtain a protective order 24 hours a day.

facts.claim_en: There are no fees or costs to file a petition.
facts.claim_es: No hay tarifas ni costos para presentar una petición.
facts.source_name: Kentucky Court of Justice: Protective Orders booklet
facts.quote: There are no fees or costs for filing a petition.

facts.claim_en: A hearing is held within 14 days to decide whether a long-term order is needed.
facts.claim_es: Se celebra una audiencia dentro de 14 días para decidir si se necesita una orden a largo plazo.
facts.source_name: Kentucky Court of Justice: Protective Orders booklet
facts.quote: within 14 days to determine whether a long-term order is needed.

official_links.label_en: Kentucky Court of Justice: Protective Orders booklet
official_links.label_es: Kentucky Court of Justice: Protective Orders booklet

facts.claim_en: A final protection from abuse order in Maine may last up to two years.
facts.claim_es: Una orden final de protección contra el abuso en Maine puede durar hasta dos años.
facts.source_name: Maine Judicial Branch: Protection from Abuse guide (PUB-001)
facts.quote: A final protection from abuse order may last up to two years.

facts.claim_en: Defendants who violate a temporary order are subject to arrest.
facts.claim_es: Los demandados que violan una orden temporal pueden ser arrestados.
facts.source_name: Maine Judicial Branch: Protection from Abuse guide (PUB-001)
facts.quote: Defendants who violate the temporary order are subject to arrest

facts.claim_en: Violating a temporary protection order is always a Class D crime.
facts.claim_es: Violar una orden de protección temporal es siempre un delito de Clase D.
facts.source_name: Maine Judicial Branch: Protection from Abuse guide (PUB-001)
facts.quote: Violation of a temporary protection order is always a Class D crime

official_links.label_en: Maine Judicial Branch: Protection from Abuse guide (PUB-001)
official_links.label_es: Maine Judicial Branch: Protection from Abuse guide (PUB-001)

facts.claim_en: The Protective Order hearing is held within 7 days of the ex parte order.
facts.claim_es: La audiencia de la Orden de Protección se celebra dentro de los 7 días de la orden ex parte.
facts.source_name: Maryland Judiciary: Charles County Circuit Court Family
facts.quote: called a Protective Order hearing, which will be held within 7 days.

facts.claim_en: Relief under a Maryland Protective Order can last up to 1 year.
facts.claim_es: Las medidas de una Orden de Protección en Maryland pueden durar hasta 1 año.
facts.source_name: Maryland Judiciary: Charles County Circuit Court Family
facts.quote: Relief granted under the Protective Order can be up to 1 year.

facts.claim_en: Violating the Protective Order is a crime.
facts.claim_es: Violar la Orden de Protección es un delito.
facts.source_name: Maryland Judiciary: Charles County Circuit Court Family
facts.quote: Violation of the Protective Order is a crime.

official_links.label_en: Maryland Judiciary: Charles County Circuit Court Family
official_links.label_es: Maryland Judiciary: Charles County Circuit Court Family

facts.claim_en: In Michigan, an adult found guilty of criminal contempt for violating a personal protection order faces up to 93 days in jail and a fine up to $500.
facts.claim_es: En Michigan, un adulto declarado culpable de desacato penal por violar una orden de protección personal enfrenta hasta 93 días de cárcel y una multa de hasta $500.
facts.source_name: Michigan Compiled Laws § 600.2950
facts.quote: imprisonment for not more than 93 days and a fine of not more than $500.00

facts.claim_en: The restrained person in Michigan may file a motion to modify or rescind the order and request a hearing within 14 days after being served or notified.
facts.claim_es: En Michigan, la persona restringida puede presentar una moción para modificar o anular la orden y pedir una audiencia dentro de los 14 días después de ser notificada.
facts.source_name: Michigan Compiled Laws § 600.2950
facts.quote: may file a motion to modify or rescind the personal protection order and request a hearing within 14 days after the individual restrained or enjoined has been served or has received actual notice of the order

facts.claim_en: A Michigan personal protection order issued without prior notice (ex parte) is valid for at least 182 days.
facts.claim_es: En Michigan, una orden de protección personal emitida sin aviso previo (ex parte) es válida por al menos 182 días.
facts.source_name: Michigan Compiled Laws § 600.2950
facts.quote: A personal protection order issued under subsection (12) is valid for not less than 182 days.

facts.claim_en: Minnesota waives the filing fees for an order for protection for both the petitioner and the respondent.
facts.claim_es: Minnesota exime de las tarifas de presentación de una orden de protección tanto a la parte peticionaria como a la parte demandada.
facts.source_name: Minnesota Statutes § 518B.01
facts.quote: The filing fees for an order for protection under this section are waived for the petitioner and respondent.

facts.claim_en: Unless an ex parte order is issued, a Minnesota court holds the hearing no later than 14 days after ordering it.
facts.claim_es: Salvo que se dicte una orden ex parte, un tribunal de Minnesota celebra la audiencia a más tardar 14 días después de ordenarla.
facts.source_name: Minnesota Statutes § 518B.01
facts.quote: the court shall order a hearing which shall be held not later than 14 days from the date of the order for hearing unless an ex parte order is issued

facts.claim_en: In Minnesota, a respondent served fewer than five days before the hearing may ask for a continuance of up to five days.
facts.claim_es: En Minnesota, la parte demandada notificada menos de cinco días antes de la audiencia puede pedir un aplazamiento de hasta cinco días.
facts.source_name: Minnesota Statutes § 518B.01
facts.quote: the respondent at the hearing may request a continuance of up to five days if served fewer than five days prior to the hearing

facts.claim_en: A Missouri full order of protection is valid for at least 180 days and no more than one year.
facts.claim_es: En Misuri, una orden de protección completa es válida por al menos 180 días y no más de un año.
facts.source_name: Missouri Revised Statutes § 455.040
facts.quote: the protective order shall be valid for at least one hundred eighty days and not more than one year

facts.claim_en: If a Missouri court finds in writing that the respondent poses a serious danger, the order can last from two to ten years.
facts.claim_es: Si un tribunal de Misuri determina por escrito que la parte demandada representa un peligro grave, la orden puede durar de dos a diez años.
facts.source_name: Missouri Revised Statutes § 455.040
facts.quote: the protective order shall be valid for at least two years and not more than ten years

facts.claim_en: A Missouri full order of protection can be renewed after a hearing, on the petitioner's motion.
facts.claim_es: En Misuri, una orden de protección completa puede renovarse después de una audiencia, a solicitud de la parte peticionaria.
facts.source_name: Missouri Revised Statutes § 455.040
facts.quote: Upon motion by the petitioner, and after a hearing by the court, the full order of protection ma

facts.claim_en: There are no costs for a Nebraska protection order unless a judge finds you lied or asked for it for inappropriate reasons.
facts.claim_es: Una orden de protección en Nebraska no tiene costo, salvo que un juez determine que usted mintió o la pidió por razones indebidas.
facts.source_name: Nebraska Judicial Branch: Protection Order FAQ
facts.quote: There are no costs unless a judge decides that you lied or asked for the protection order for inappropriate reasons.

facts.claim_en: An ex parte protection order lasts until you go to court.
facts.claim_es: Una orden de protección ex parte dura hasta que usted va al tribunal.
facts.source_name: Nebraska Judicial Branch: Protection Order FAQ
facts.quote: An “ex parte” protection order lasts until you go to court.

facts.claim_en: At court, the judge decides whether to cancel the order or continue it for one year.
facts.claim_es: En el tribunal, el juez decide si cancela la orden o la extiende por un año.
facts.source_name: Nebraska Judicial Branch: Protection Order FAQ
facts.quote: At court, the judge decides if the protection order will be canceled or continued for one year.

facts.claim_en: A Domestic Abuse Protection Order may include a custody order lasting up to 90 days.
facts.claim_es: Una Orden de Protección contra el Abuso Doméstico puede incluir una orden de custodia de hasta 90 días.
facts.source_name: Nebraska Judicial Branch: Protection Order FAQ
facts.quote: If you qualify for a Domestic Abuse Protection Order, you may get an order for custody, which may last up to 90 days.

official_links.label_en: Nebraska Judicial Branch: Protection Order FAQ
official_links.label_es: Nebraska Judicial Branch: Protection Order FAQ

facts.claim_en: A Nevada temporary protection order against domestic violence lasts no more than 45 days, as the court sets.
facts.claim_es: En Nevada, una orden temporal de protección contra la violencia doméstica dura como máximo 45 días, según fije el tribunal.
facts.source_name: Nevada Revised Statutes chapter 33
facts.quote: A temporary order expires within such time, not to exceed 45 days, as the court fixes.

facts.claim_en: A Nevada extended order lasts no more than 2 years, as the court sets.
facts.claim_es: En Nevada, una orden extendida dura como máximo 2 años, según fije el tribunal.
facts.source_name: Nevada Revised Statutes chapter 33
facts.quote: An extended order expires within such time, not to exceed 2 years, as the court fixes.

facts.claim_en: In Nevada, a hearing on an extended order must be held within 45 days after the application is filed.
facts.claim_es: En Nevada, la audiencia sobre una orden extendida debe celebrarse dentro de los 45 días después de presentar la solicitud.
facts.source_name: Nevada Revised Statutes chapter 33
facts.quote: A hearing on an application for an extended order must be held within 45 days after the date on which the application for the extended order is filed.

facts.claim_en: The Nevada court clerk does not charge an applicant for a certified copy of the temporary or extended order.
facts.claim_es: En Nevada, el secretario del tribunal no cobra al solicitante por una copia certificada de la orden temporal o extendida.
facts.source_name: Nevada Revised Statutes chapter 33
facts.quote: The clerk of the court shall not charge an applicant for a temporary or extended order for providing the applicant with a certified copy of the temporary or extended order.

facts.claim_en: A New Hampshire domestic violence protective order is for a fixed period of up to one year.
facts.claim_es: En Nuevo Hampshire, una orden de protección por violencia doméstica dura un período fijo de hasta un año.
facts.source_name: New Hampshire RSA 173-B:5
facts.quote: Any order under this section shall be for a fixed period of time not to exceed one year

facts.claim_en: In New Hampshire, the first extension is for one year, and later extensions may be for up to 5 years.
facts.claim_es: En Nuevo Hampshire, la primera prórroga es de un año, y las siguientes pueden ser de hasta 5 años.
facts.source_name: New Hampshire RSA 173-B:5
facts.quote: for one year after the expiration of the first order and thereafter each extension may be for up to 5 years

facts.claim_en: A New Hampshire defendant can have a hearing on an extension within 30 days.
facts.claim_es: En Nuevo Hampshire, la parte demandada puede tener una audiencia sobre la prórroga dentro de 30 días.
facts.source_name: New Hampshire RSA 173-B:5
facts.quote: A defendant shall have the right to a hearing on the extension of any order under this paragraph to be held within 30 days of the extension.

facts.claim_en: After a temporary restraining order (TRO), the plaintiff gets a final restraining order hearing date within 10 days.
facts.claim_es: Después de una orden de restricción temporal (TRO), la parte demandante recibe una fecha de audiencia para la orden final dentro de 10 días.
facts.source_name: New Jersey Courts: Domestic Violence FAQ
facts.quote: the plaintiff will be given a date to return for a final restraining order (FRO) hearing within 10 days.

facts.claim_en: On weekends, evenings and holidays, you can go to your local police department to file a complaint.
facts.claim_es: Los fines de semana, por la noche y en días feriados, puede ir a la policía local para presentar una denuncia.
facts.source_name: New Jersey Courts: Domestic Violence FAQ
facts.quote: Weekend, evenings, and holidays, go to your local police department to file a complaint.

facts.claim_en: New Jersey's 1991 Prevention of Domestic Violence Act lists the crimes that count as domestic violence.
facts.claim_es: La Ley de Prevención de la Violencia Doméstica de 1991 de Nueva Jersey enumera los delitos que cuentan como violencia doméstica.
facts.source_name: New Jersey Courts: Domestic Violence FAQ
facts.quote: Domestic violence occurs when one of the crimes listed below is committed against a person protected under the 1991 Prevention of Domestic Violence Act (PDVA).

official_links.label_en: New Jersey Courts: Domestic Violence FAQ
official_links.label_es: New Jersey Courts: Domestic Violence FAQ

facts.claim_en: A New York criminal court order of protection can only be issued against someone charged with a crime.
facts.claim_es: En Nueva York, una orden de protección del tribunal penal solo se puede dictar contra alguien acusado de un delito.
facts.source_name: New York State Office for the Prevention of Domestic Violence: Orders of Protection
facts.quote: A criminal court order of protection can only be issued against a person who has been charged with a crime.

facts.claim_en: You cannot violate your own order or be arrested for contacting the person you are protected from.
facts.claim_es: Usted no puede violar su propia orden ni ser arrestado por contactar a la persona de quien está protegido.
facts.source_name: New York State Office for the Prevention of Domestic Violence: Orders of Protection
facts.quote: You cannot violate your own order by contacting the person you are protected from, and you cannot be arrested for contacting them.

facts.claim_en: The District Attorney may be able to handle the case without you if there is other evidence.
facts.claim_es: El Fiscal de Distrito puede llevar el caso sin usted si hay otras pruebas.
facts.source_name: New York State Office for the Prevention of Domestic Violence: Orders of Protection
facts.quote: The District Attorney may be able to handle the case without you if there is other evidence of the crime.

official_links.label_en: New York State Office for the Prevention of Domestic Violence: Orders of Protection
official_links.label_es: New York State Office for the Prevention of Domestic Violence: Orders of Protection

facts.claim_en: A North Carolina permanent DVPO can last up to one year and can be renewed for up to two years at a time.
facts.claim_es: Una DVPO permanente en Carolina del Norte puede durar hasta un año y renovarse por hasta dos años cada vez.
facts.source_name: North Carolina Judicial Branch: How to Get a Protection Order
facts.quote: a “permanent” DVPO can last for up to one year, but can be renewed for up to two years at a time.

facts.claim_en: A defendant can be arrested and criminally charged for violating a DVPO.
facts.claim_es: El demandado puede ser arrestado y acusado penalmente por violar una DVPO.
facts.source_name: North Carolina Judicial Branch: How to Get a Protection Order
facts.quote: A defendant can be arrested and criminally charged for violating a DVPO.

facts.claim_en: Police will not arrest a defendant for violating a 50C (civil no-contact) order.
facts.claim_es: La policía no arrestará al demandado por violar una orden 50C (de no contacto civil).
facts.source_name: North Carolina Judicial Branch: How to Get a Protection Order
facts.quote: the police will not arrest a defendant for violating a 50C order.

official_links.label_en: North Carolina Judicial Branch: How to Get a Protection Order
official_links.label_es: North Carolina Judicial Branch: How to Get a Protection Order

facts.claim_en: In Ohio, violating a protection order is generally a first-degree misdemeanor.
facts.claim_es: En Ohio, violar una orden de protección es generalmente un delito menor de primer grado.
facts.source_name: Ohio Revised Code § 2919.27
facts.quote: violating a protection order is a misdemeanor of the first degree.

facts.claim_en: It is a third-degree felony if the order is violated while committing a felony.
facts.claim_es: Es un delito grave de tercer grado si la orden se viola mientras se comete un delito grave.
facts.source_name: Ohio Revised Code § 2919.27
facts.quote: If the offender violates a protection order or consent agreement while committing a felony offense, violating a protection order is a felony of the third degree.

facts.claim_en: A protection order under this section lasts until a set date no later than five years from issuance.
facts.claim_es: Una orden de protección bajo esta sección dura hasta una fecha fija, no más de cinco años desde su emisión.
facts.source_name: Ohio Revised Code § 2903.214
facts.quote: Any protection order issued pursuant to this section shall be valid until a date certain but not later than five years from the date of its issuance.

facts.claim_en: There is no cost to file for a protection order in Pennsylvania.
facts.claim_es: No cuesta nada pedir una orden de protección en Pensilvania.
facts.source_name: Unified Judicial System of Pennsylvania: Protection Orders
facts.quote: There is no cost to file for a protection order.

facts.claim_en: If the order is violated, police can arrest the abuser and a contempt hearing will be held.
facts.claim_es: Si se viola la orden, la policía puede arrestar al agresor y se celebrará una audiencia por desacato.
facts.source_name: Unified Judicial System of Pennsylvania: Protection Orders
facts.quote: The police can arrest the abuser and a contempt hearing will be held.

facts.claim_en: Legal counsel can represent a victim at no cost, but it is not required.
facts.claim_es: Un abogado puede representar a la víctima sin costo, pero no es obligatorio.
facts.source_name: Unified Judicial System of Pennsylvania: Protection Orders
facts.quote: Legal counsel can represent a victim at no cost, but it is not required.

official_links.label_en: Unified Judicial System of Pennsylvania: Protection Orders
official_links.label_es: Unified Judicial System of Pennsylvania: Protection Orders

facts.claim_en: Under Rhode Island law, knowingly violating the firearm ban in a protective order is a felony with a fine up to $1,000, one to five years in prison, or both.
facts.claim_es: Según la ley de Rhode Island, violar a sabiendas la prohibición de armas de fuego de una orden de protección es un delito grave con multa de hasta $1,000, de uno a cinco años de prisión, o ambas.
facts.source_name: Rhode Island General Laws § 15-15-3
facts.quote: Any knowing violation of this subsection is a felony that shall be punishable by a fine of not more than one thousand dollars ($1,000), or by imprisonment for a term of not less than one year and not more than five (5) years, or both.

facts.claim_en: A Rhode Island protective order can require child support for up to 90 days.
facts.claim_es: Una orden de protección en Rhode Island puede exigir manutención infantil por hasta 90 días.
facts.source_name: Rhode Island General Laws § 15-15-3
facts.quote: to make payments for the support of a minor child or children of the parties as required by law for a period not to exceed ninety (90) days

facts.claim_en: In Rhode Island, a hearing on firearm restrictions is held within 15 days of surrendering the firearms.
facts.claim_es: En Rhode Island, la audiencia sobre restricciones de armas de fuego se celebra dentro de los 15 días de la entrega de las armas.
facts.source_name: Rhode Island General Laws § 15-15-3
facts.quote: which shall be held within fifteen (15) days of surrendering said firearms

facts.claim_en: A South Dakota protection order can last at most five years.
facts.claim_es: Una orden de protección en Dakota del Sur puede durar como máximo cinco años.
facts.source_name: South Dakota Unified Judicial System: Protection Orders
facts.quote: The maximum time for a protection order is five years.

facts.claim_en: The person filing must appear at the hearing and be ready to give evidence or bring witnesses.
facts.claim_es: Quien presenta debe comparecer a la audiencia y estar listo para presentar pruebas o testigos.
facts.source_name: South Dakota Unified Judicial System: Protection Orders
facts.quote: the person filing must appear and be prepared to give evidence or have witnesses to explain to the judge why the protection order is needed.

facts.claim_en: The judge may also make a decision about firearms.
facts.claim_es: El juez también puede tomar una decisión sobre armas de fuego.
facts.source_name: South Dakota Unified Judicial System: Protection Orders
facts.quote: The judge may also make a determination regarding firearms.

official_links.label_en: South Dakota Unified Judicial System: Protection Orders
official_links.label_es: South Dakota Unified Judicial System: Protection Orders

facts.claim_en: If the respondent violates a Utah protective order or stalking injunction, they can be arrested and charged with a crime.
facts.claim_es: Si la parte demandada viola una orden de protección o un interdicto por acecho en Utah, puede ser arrestada y acusada de un delito.
facts.source_name: Utah State Courts Self-Help: Protective Orders
facts.quote: If the respondent violates a protective order or stalking injunction, they can be arrested and charged with a crime.

facts.claim_en: The Utah domestic violence line is toll-free at 800-897-5465.
facts.claim_es: La línea de violencia doméstica de Utah es gratuita: 800-897-5465.
facts.source_name: Utah State Courts Self-Help: Protective Orders
facts.quote: Call toll-free: 800-897-5465

facts.claim_en: Legal Aid Society of Salt Lake may offer free representation if you qualify.
facts.claim_es: La Sociedad de Ayuda Legal de Salt Lake puede ofrecer representación gratuita si usted califica.
facts.source_name: Utah State Courts Self-Help: Protective Orders
facts.quote: Contact Legal Aid Society of Salt Lake to see if you qualify for free representation.

official_links.label_en: Utah State Courts Self-Help: Protective Orders
official_links.label_es: Utah State Courts Self-Help: Protective Orders

facts.claim_en: Child support in a Vermont relief from abuse case can be ordered for at most 90 days.
facts.claim_es: En un caso de alivio por abuso en Vermont, la manutención se puede ordenar por un máximo de 90 días.
facts.source_name: Vermont Judiciary: Relief from Abuse
facts.quote: The maximum amount of time that child support can be ordered in a relief from abuse case is 90 days.

facts.claim_en: Custody or visitation terms in the order end when the order expires.
facts.claim_es: Los términos de custodia o visitas en la orden terminan cuando la orden vence.
facts.source_name: Vermont Judiciary: Relief from Abuse
facts.quote: Any custody or visitation terms in this RFA order will end when the order expires.

facts.claim_en: Violating the order can lead to criminal charges.
facts.claim_es: Violar la orden puede llevar a cargos penales.
facts.source_name: Vermont Judiciary: Relief from Abuse
facts.quote: You can be charged with a crime in criminal court if you violate this order.

facts.claim_en: A Virginia permanent (full) protective order can be issued for up to two years.
facts.claim_es: Una orden de protección permanente en Virginia puede dictarse por hasta dos años.
facts.source_name: Virginia Judicial System: Protective Orders in Virginia guide
facts.quote: Permanent Protective Order--a full protective order can be issued for up to two years

facts.claim_en: Virginia VINE Protective Order provides free notifications about protective orders.
facts.claim_es: Virginia VINE Protective Order envía notificaciones gratuitas sobre órdenes de protección.
facts.source_name: Virginia Judicial System: Protective Orders in Virginia guide
facts.quote: Virginia VINE Protective Order (VPO) - provides free notifications about preliminary and

facts.claim_en: A final protective order must be issued for 12 months or longer to apply for certain benefits listed in the guide.
facts.claim_es: Una orden de protección final debe ser de 12 meses o más para solicitar ciertos beneficios que indica la guía.
facts.source_name: Virginia Judicial System: Protective Orders in Virginia guide
facts.quote: Your final protective order must be issued for 12 months or longer to apply for and receive

official_links.label_en: Virginia Judicial System: Protective Orders in Virginia guide
official_links.label_es: Virginia Judicial System: Protective Orders in Virginia guide

facts.claim_en: In Washington, a petitioner does not have to post a bond to get a protection order.
facts.claim_es: En Washington, la parte peticionaria no tiene que depositar una fianza para obtener una orden de protección.
facts.source_name: Revised Code of Washington § 7.105.105
facts.quote: A petitioner is not required to post a bond to obtain relief in any proceeding for a protection order.

facts.claim_en: Washington courts and public agencies may not charge petitioners fees for service of process on a protection order.
facts.claim_es: En Washington, los tribunales y las agencias públicas no pueden cobrar a las partes peticionarias por la notificación de una orden de protección.
facts.source_name: Revised Code of Washington § 7.105.105
facts.quote: No fees for service of process may be charged by a court or any public agency to petitioners seeking relief under this chapter.

facts.claim_en: Except for antiharassment orders, a Washington court does not grant a protection order for less than one year unless the petitioner asks for a shorter period.
facts.claim_es: Salvo en órdenes contra el acoso, un tribunal de Washington no concede una orden de protección por menos de un año a menos que la parte peticionaria pida un plazo más corto.
facts.source_name: Revised Code of Washington § 7.105.315
facts.quote: Other than for antiharassment orders, the court shall not grant relief for less than one year unless the petitioner has specifically requested relief for a shorter period of time.

facts.claim_en: A West Virginia family court protective order lasts either 90 days or 180 days, at the court's discretion.
facts.claim_es: En Virginia Occidental, una orden de protección del tribunal de familia dura 90 o 180 días, a criterio del tribunal.
facts.source_name: West Virginia Code § 48-27-505
facts.quote: is effective for either ninety days or one hundred eighty days, in the discretion of the court

facts.claim_en: If the petitioner asks in writing before it expires, the West Virginia family court extends the order for another 90 days.
facts.claim_es: Si la parte peticionaria lo pide por escrito antes del vencimiento, el tribunal de familia de Virginia Occidental prorroga la orden por otros 90 días.
facts.source_name: West Virginia Code § 48-27-505
facts.quote: Upon receipt of a written request for renewal from the petitioner prior to the expiration of the original order, the family court shall extend its order for an additional ninety-day period.

facts.claim_en: A West Virginia court may enter a one-year protective order after a hearing if it finds aggravating factors.
facts.claim_es: Un tribunal de Virginia Occidental puede dictar una orden de protección de un año después de una audiencia si encuentra factores agravantes.
facts.source_name: West Virginia Code § 48-27-505
facts.quote: the court may enter a protective order for a period of one year if the court finds by a preponderance of the evidence, after a hearing that any of the following aggravating factors are present

facts.claim_en: In Wisconsin, a hearing on a domestic abuse injunction is held within 14 days after the temporary restraining order is issued, unless extended.
facts.claim_es: En Wisconsin, la audiencia sobre una orden judicial por abuso doméstico se celebra dentro de los 14 días después de emitir la orden de restricción temporal, salvo prórroga.
facts.source_name: Wisconsin Statutes § 813.12
facts.quote: shall hold a hearing on issuance of an injunction within 14 days after the temporary restraining order is issued

facts.claim_en: A Wisconsin domestic abuse injunction lasts for the period the petitioner requests, up to 4 years.
facts.claim_es: En Wisconsin, una orden judicial por abuso doméstico dura el tiempo que pida la parte peticionaria, hasta 4 años.
facts.source_name: Wisconsin Statutes § 813.12
facts.quote: is effective according to its terms, for the period of time that the petitioner requests, but not more than 4 years

facts.claim_en: A Wisconsin court can make a domestic abuse injunction last up to 10 years if it finds certain conditions on the record.
facts.claim_es: Un tribunal de Wisconsin puede hacer que una orden judicial por abuso doméstico dure hasta 10 años si constata ciertas condiciones en el expediente.
facts.source_name: Wisconsin Statutes § 813.12
facts.quote: order that the injunction is in effect for not more than 10 years, if the court finds, by a preponderance of the evidence stated on the record
